editorial_campaign.scope: PCDF 111 canonical reviews; RO 118 decisions (115 activated/three archived); PE 38 decisions (36 activated/two obsolete); MG five decisions (three activated/two archived). Other-session progress is not claimed as our editorial approval. Not certification of all PC records. MT: six records activated (three shared questions, two careers), not six distinct physical questions. SE: two records (one common historical item), using the explicit official appeal justification. Not certification of the full SE exams. AM: one Delegado item (25), confirmed with Tema 1100, final key and updated official program; item 44 retained. RO Delegado item 29: LEP sanction and explicit execution-penal program verified; not certification of all remaining items.
editorial_campaign.coverage_note: Count means not tracked by this campaign, not necessarily unaudited. Twenty-nine pending records were activated by another session between snapshots and were preserved, without our certification of that review.

validation.scope_note: All 2956 other PC question records preserved. Metadata comparison separately observed external topic changes; planned source/edition/topic writes matched and were not overwritten.
